description: Grow the lot's buildable size (byte index into VMBuildableAreaInfo.BuildableSizes) and/or stories (0..3). Size-down and no-op are server-rejected. Prerequisite: you are the lot owner (handler-side; server-side Owner via VMTSOAvatarPermissions.Owner). A transaction is required: the server calls GlobalLink.PerformTransaction for baseCost + roomieCost; if funds are insufficient the resize is silently cancelled. Effect: vm.TSOState.Size packed field changes; visible via query-lot.size_tiles / floors. Cost: VMBuildableAreaInfo.CalculateBaseCost(oldTotal, newTotal) + CalculateRoomieCost per roommate. Wire: VMNetChangeLotSizeCmd { LotSize, LotStories }.
